from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import product

# Exact-arithmetic check of whether the mannikin suspects the wolf.
# Unknown atoms are enumerated: B = butterfly smiles at mannikin,

def fits_with_rotation(box_a, box_b):
    # Exact rational comparison, allowing 90-degree rotation.
    a = sorted(Fraction(x) for x in box_a)
    b = sorted(Fraction(x) for x in box_b)
    return all(x <= y for x, y in zip(a, b))
